description: Get full details of one product by id: specs, price, stock, MOQ, merchant name. The collected_at field shows when price/stock were last recorded - always check data_age_days before quoting prices (over 30 days = stale, verify with merchant). Public read-only, no auth required. If the id does not exist, returns an error message (not an empty result). Use this when you already have a product id from search_stocks; use search_stocks instead to find products by keyword.

id.description: Product id, copy it from the id field of a search_stocks result

name: get_stock
